title: fix(live-preview): preserve table text drag selection
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Preserve partial native text selections inside rendered table cells after mouse drag.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

Dragging to select part of a rendered table cell could be restored as the whole cell text during the native selection stabilization flow.

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`: prefer the mouse hit-test range when stabilizing table-cell text selection, falling back to the browser selection only when hit testing is unavailable.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) passes
- [x] Existing vitest regression covers partial table-cell text selection
